title: Melodic Plushies!
description: sum plushies n a sewing system for em :P
body:
Plushies and a sewing system!
Craft a Sewing Needle and some Stuffed Wool and start sewing away :>

# Sewing:
![Sewing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3675df6bbeb5e5e730784f97817de2d8ea6b42ba_0.webp)

To start sewing. You'll need a Sewing Needle, craft it by putting 2 iron nuggets horizontally, and an iron ingot at the end of the horizontal line in the crafting grid. Get stuffed wool by crafting wool with string.

put the stuffed wool on your "off-hand", and with your Sewing needle on your main hand to start sewing plushies!
